name: J2ME
summary: Java phone games from the 2000s, as their own console.
description: Adds a J2ME system with its own ROM folder, the FreeJ2ME-Plus libretro core that runs it, and the Java runtime that core needs. There is no app to open: installing this pak makes a J2ME tile appear alongside your consoles, and your .jar and .kjx games go in Roms/J2ME. Removing the pak removes the core and its Java runtime with it.
author: Utility Muffin Research Kitchen
